reviewer: assistant_only; text/context review independently of retrieval rankings

terminology.microinverter: Explicit microinverter(s); small generic inverter alone is partial.
terminology.inverter: Explicit inverter(s), including contextually valid microinverter subtype; inverse/reverser is incorrect.
terminology.transformer_bushing: Explicit electrical/transformer bushing(s). Generic tube/holster is incorrect; insulating sleeve is partial.
terminology.cooling_fins: Explicit cooling/radiator/heat-dissipating fins. Broader heat sink or radiator is partial, not explicit visible-fin credit.

context: Evaluate original Chinese wording and unedited generated English without using rankings or model scores.
Grade wiring presence, opening/closure, mounting support and under/behind/between relationships separately when source asks for them.
A required word present in an appended fragment is not automatically a faithful term-in-context or whole-sentence translation.
For negation, visibility, AND/OR or device ownership, check attachment and polarity, not only substring presence.
Never rewrite outputs, change the glossary or tune per-query weights after seeing test results.
Use new query annotation-notes for source expectations; do not feed reference English to the translator.
limitations: Assistant review is not independent human domain truth.
Terminology constraints do not guarantee relational semantics.
